relationships.subject: vincristine
relationships.evidence_quote: GAD67, responsible for > 90% of basal GABA synthesis, is down-regulated, while its relative mRNA remains unchanged in vincristine-induced neuropathy

relationships.subject: miR-30d
relationships.evidence_quote: miR-30d could affect the fluorescence activity of GAD67 by binding to the 3 'UTR of the GAD67 gene

relationships.subject: miR-30d antagomir
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal injection of miR-30d antagomir increased the expression of GAD67, partially rescued vincristine-induced thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia

relationships.subject: miR-30d antagomir
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal injection of miR-30d antagomir increased the expression of GAD67, partially rescued vincristine-induced thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia

key_findings: Vincristine reduces spinal GAD67 protein but not mRNA; miR-30d binds the GAD67 3'UTR.
Intrathecal miR-30d antagomir restores GAD67 and partially rescues vincristine-induced hyperalgesia and allodynia.
